title: Rheno 1

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Fuck it. Look I’m only gonna give you this because, big shock, CorpSec missed it. It’s probably nothing, but I found it next to the victim’s Comm and it could give you a lead. Don’t get your hopes up though shoku, the trail is as dead as the guy who rented this apartment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck it. Look I’m only gonna give you this because, big shock, CorpSec missed it. It’s probably nothing, but I found it next to the victim’s Comm and it could give you a lead. Don’t get your hopes up though shoku, the trail is as dead as the guy who rented this apartment.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Are you a trauma junkie? You look like a trauma junkie. I can see it in your eyes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you a trauma junkie? You look like a trauma junkie. I can see it in your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A what?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You know, those freaks who get horny for misplaced viscera. Posting pictures of themselves on the Feeds with corpses for clout. World's gone mad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, those freaks who get horny for misplaced viscera. Posting pictures of themselves on the Feeds with corpses for clout. World's gone mad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not why I'm here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not why I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could ask you the same thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could ask you the same thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I could ask you the same thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I could ask you the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Well if you were, you’d know there’s nothing to see at an Aseptic scene.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well if you were, you’d know there’s nothing to see at an Aseptic scene.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Word of advice, Shoku. Rule No.1 in this town as far as I'm concerned: Don't go around asking Aftermath Technicians if they're trauma junkies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Word of advice, Shoku. Rule No.1 in this town as far as I'm concerned: Don't go around asking Aftermath Technicians if they're trauma junkies.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: You think I'm dressed like this for fun, Shoku? Never seen an Aftermath Technician before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I'm dressed like this for fun, Shoku? Never seen an Aftermath Technician before?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aftermath Technician?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aftermath Technician?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You look like some kind of cleaner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You look like some kind of cleaner.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You look like some kind of cleaner.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You look like some kind of cleaner.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Some kind? The kind. "No corpse too bloated, no blood too obsene. From homicide to suicide, we'll get your place cleaned!" Or so they say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some kind? The kind. "No corpse too bloated, no blood too obsene. From homicide to suicide, we'll get your place cleaned!" Or so they say.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: "No corpse too bloated, no blood too obscene. From homicide to suicide, we'll get your place cleaned!"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "No corpse too bloated, no blood too obscene. From homicide to suicide, we'll get your place cleaned!"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you work for CorpSec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you work for CorpSec?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like a horrible job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like a horrible job.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds like a horrible job.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds like a horrible job.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: All I know is, I've never failed a psyche assessment more than two or three times in a row, that's good enough for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All I know is, I've never failed a psyche assessment more than two or three times in a row, that's good enough for me.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Fuck CorpSec, no I'm freelance. Last thing Corpster landlords want is a corpse bloating on their herringbone parquet floor. That's when they call me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck CorpSec, no I'm freelance. Last thing Corpster landlords want is a corpse bloating on their herringbone parquet floor. That's when they call me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you sanitize a lot of Aseptic scenes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you sanitize a lot of Aseptic scenes?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you sanitize a lot of Aseptic scenes?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you sanitize a lot of Aseptic scenes?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: "Sanitize" is a strong word. Between you and me, Aseptic jobs are the most boring jobs in the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Sanitize" is a strong word. Between you and me, Aseptic jobs are the most boring jobs in the city.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Boring? Someone died!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boring? Someone died!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Occupational hazard I'm afraid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Occupational hazard I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why are Aseptic jobs so boring?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why are Aseptic jobs so boring?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why are Aseptic jobs so boring?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why are Aseptic jobs so boring?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Do you not read the Holos? You know why Aseptic got his name don’t you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you not read the Holos? You know why Aseptic got his name don’t you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enlighten me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enlighten me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He leaves no trace?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He leaves no trace?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Bingo. Nothing. Nada. All we have to do is give the place a little spray down, make sure the victim didn't shit themselves - that happens a lot- and then be on our way. I've won the 'Clean-Scene' award more times than I can remember, but whoever this is runs sterilized-rings round me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bingo. Nothing. Nada. All we have to do is give the place a little spray down, make sure the victim didn't shit themselves - that happens a lot- and then be on our way. I've won the 'Clean-Scene' award more times than I can remember, but whoever this is runs sterilized-rings round me.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I've been doing this a long time. Too Long. But I've never seen anything like it. Not so much as a particulate left at any of his gigs. I've won the 'Clean-Scene' award more times than I can remember, whoever this is runs sterilized-rings round me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been doing this a long time. Too Long. But I've never seen anything like it. Not so much as a particulate left at any of his gigs. I've won the 'Clean-Scene' award more times than I can remember, whoever this is runs sterilized-rings round me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about CorpSec? They must have found something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about CorpSec? They must have found something?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What about CorpSec? They must have found something?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What about CorpSec? They must have found something?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Not as far as I know, but CorpSec couldn't spot rot-stain in their own lobby so I wouldn't hold out much hope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not as far as I know, but CorpSec couldn't spot rot-stain in their own lobby so I wouldn't hold out much hope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not a fan of CorpSec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not a fan of CorpSec?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Look, those Curzona debt-hungry Corpsters own my whole family. I know, any day now, I’m gonna rock up to one of these jobs and that’ll be my cousin or aunt lying there. Could even be me. As good for me economically as he is, it's hard to run a business from a morgue freezer. Ain't a chance CorpSec got what it takes to solve this one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, those Curzona debt-hungry Corpsters own my whole family. I know, any day now, I’m gonna rock up to one of these jobs and that’ll be my cousin or aunt lying there. Could even be me. As good for me economically as he is, it's hard to run a business from a morgue freezer. Ain't a chance CorpSec got what it takes to solve this one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's worrying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's worrying.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm going to find him myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going to find him myself.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm going to find him myself.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm going to find him myself.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Cute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cute.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sure you don't have anything to go on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure you don't have anything to go on?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You sure you don't have anything to go on?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You sure you don't have anything to go on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you admire Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you admire Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Admire? No. I'm allowed to have a respect for the craft though, right? All I'm saying is, if I were to ever go on my own cold-blooded killing spree, I'd take a leaf out of old Aseptic's book, that's for sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Admire? No. I'm allowed to have a respect for the craft though, right? All I'm saying is, if I were to ever go on my own cold-blooded killing spree, I'd take a leaf out of old Aseptic's book, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like the outfit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like the outfit.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Well... Uh... Thanks I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... Uh... Thanks I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is an Aftermath Technician?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is an Aftermath Technician?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds like you offer a very important service.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds like you offer a very important service.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It sounds like you offer a very important service.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It sounds like you offer a very important service.

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: I do what I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do what I can.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Clean Scene award? I'm impressed!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Clean Scene award? I'm impressed!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The Clean Scene award? I'm impressed!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The Clean Scene award? I'm impressed!

nodes.speaker: Rheno
nodes.text: Yeah pretty big deal at the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah pretty big deal at the time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe us citizens could sort this mess out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe us citizens could sort this mess out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe us citizens could sort this mess out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe us citizens could sort this mess out.
